jobs.occupation: Working Student within Structure Team NextGeneration (d/f/m) (Elektroniker/in - Luftfahrttechnische Systeme)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support the Airframe Structure Team NextGeneration, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Working Student within Structure Team NextGeneration (d/f/m)

You are a full time student (d/f/m), looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of a Research and Technology Engineer (d/f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Airframe Structure Team NextGeneration as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: 15.04.2026
- Duration: 12 months

You will receive a collectively agreed salary of at least €18.53 per hour, depending on the job. There are also special payments such as vacation pay.

Who are we

We as the Structure Team NextGen FAF (Forward and Aft Fuselage) / CAF (Center and Aft Fuselage) believe in emission free aviation. Sustainability is at our hearts and we want to be part of the journey towards clean aviation. We are innovation-driven and foster improvements together with our network. We are preparing the future of airframe engineering by creating the link between Research and Technology (R&T) projects & serial programs, delivering pre-study developments and working towards the Airbus vision of sustainable aviation! Our strategy is to act as ambassadors for new technologies (H2 (hydrogen), 3D printing /Rapid Prototyping, Bionics, ...), create business value for serial programs by integration of R&T technology bricks, set the Airframe Structure footprint in R&T projects and prepare the Structure Community to develop future aircraft programs.

You will be part of an innovation driven team taking care of technical Research&Technology projects together with our partners and customers, which is working on feasibility studies and identifying technologies which can be already implemented as incremental development steps in legacy aircraft programs.

You will focus on innovation management and describe how the as-is situation and how the to-be situation is. You will compare both situations and define together with the team potential actions. In addition you will support the Innovation dynamic project team and project leader.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Finkenwerder

Are you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- Traveling within Germany (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Support our daily activities within Research & Technology with pre-design, pre-sizing and definition of requirements together with our expert.
- Support to build up demonstrators in order to show the feasibility.
- Support on digitalisation of our workload and workforce planning.
- Support on administrative tasks like updates of websites and communication.
- Ensure operational support to the team in their daily activities.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the area of Aeronautical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or an equivalent field of study.
- Knowledge within Airframe Structure beneficial.
- Project Management experiences beneficial.
- You are a proactive, autonomous and highly motivated person with a great sense of initiative and the ability to manage confidential topics.
- You show strong communication, interpersonal and networking skills.
- Interests in the field of R&T, open-minded and innovation driven.
- Fluent in English and German, French is beneficial but not required.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

jobs.occupation: IT Inhouse Consultant – SAP S/4 Finance Consolidation & Reporting (m/f/d) (Data-Consultant)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
IT Inhouse Consultant

Stellenbeschreibung:
Company Description

Since its spin-off in September 2025 AUMOVIO continues the business of the former Continental group sector Automotive as an independent company. The technology and electronics company offers a wide-ranging portfolio that makes mobility safe, exciting, connected, and autonomous. This includes sensor solutions, displays, braking and comfort systems as well as comprehensive expertise in software, architecture platforms, and assistance systems for software-defined vehicles. In the fiscal year 2024 the business areas, which now belong to AUMOVIO, generated sales of 19.6 billion Euro. The company is headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany and has about 87.000 employees in more than 100 locations worldwide.

Job Description

As IT Inhouse Consultant – SAP S/4 Finance Consolidation & Reporting (m/f/diverse), you will be responsible for requirements recording, concept development and solution implementation of the group reporting system and technical requirements.

Your tasks will also include the following activities:

- Analyze business requirements and develop concepts for group reporting in close collaboration with the relevant departments
- Management of the implementation of these concepts, ensuring alignment with business requirements and technical feasibility
- Planning and execution of the transformation to SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting
- Drive innovation and use of new technologies in the SAP Finance area
- Integration of new reporting applications into the existing system landscape
- Continuous evaluation and optimization of existing processes and applications
- Individual user support and knowledge transfer
- Support and monitor of the reporting cycles, including administrative tasks
- Leading and coordinating internal and external project team members

Qualifications

The ideal candidate (m/f/diverse) will possess the following qualifications:

- Academic degree in Information Technology, or a comparable qualification
- Deep expertise in SAP SEM-BCS and SAP BW
- Experience with SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting and SAP Central Finance
- Knowledge of SAP BTP, SAP Analytics Cloud, and SAP Query Design
- Strong business understanding of group accounting and consolidation processes
- Excellent IT knowledge of process workflows, database architectures and system integration
- Experience in project leadership and project management
- Fluency in German and English, both spoken and written
- Strong communication skills as well as competence in conflict management

Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.

Additional Information

Ready to take your career to the next level? The future of mobility isn’t just anyone’s job. ​Make it yours! Join AUMOVIO. Own What’s Next.

jobs.occupation: Technical Expert Software Engineering (f/m/d) for Turbine Package Control Systems (Ingenieur/in - Informations-, Kommunikationstechnik)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

You start your day by reviewing project requirements and clarifying technical details with colleagues from sales, project management, and engineering. Most of your time is spent translating process specifications into functional software solutions for gas turbine control systems. You collaborate closely with global teams, attend project meetings, and ensure timely delivery of hardware and software packages. Occasionally, you provide on-site support during commissioning or assist with prototype implementations in the service fleet.
Depending on your interests the development to a technical integrator and coordinator between sales, project management and controls engineering is possible. We are looking for a dedicated Project Software Engineer for Turbine Package Controls to strengthen our customer order engineering team.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Technical clarification of process requirements and interfaces for gas turbine, generator, and auxiliary systems in new apparatus and service projects
* Assurance of reference design application for engine upgrades and development of project-specific software solutions where required
* Creation of hardware specifications for I&C components
* On-time provision of functional software and hardware solutions within quality, budget, and design requirements
* Representation of gas turbine controls scope within project teams and in customer meetings
* Provision of qualified site support during erection and commissioning, including problem-solving for process engineering issues relevant to control engineering

What You Bring

* Bachelor or Master in electrical or mechanical engineering (or equivalent)
* Several years of experience in engineering and/or commissioning of control systems, preferably in the energy sector 
* Knowledge of state-of-the-art control system hardware and professional experience with SPPA-T3000, PCS7, or equivalent environments 
* Openness to new technologies and collaborative working styles 
* Strong team orientation, ownership mindset, and result-driven approach 
* Good command of English and German languages 

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Cybersecurity Specialist for Vulnerability Management (f/m/d) (Informationssicherheitsbeauftragte/r)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Snapshot of Your Day 

Our Industrial Cybersecurity department is seeking a highly qualified and driven industrial cybersecurity specialist to support vulnerability management efforts within the Product and Solutions domain. As an Industrial Cybersecurity Specialist, you will play a critical role in ensuring the security posture of wind power plants by proactively identifying and supporting the remediation of potential security risks.
You will become part of the Industrial Cybersecurity Technical Competence Center (TCC), a diverse and international team of experienced cybersecurity professionals supporting the business and development teams in securing systems by default across Product and Solutions, Manufacturing IT and Business managed IT.
In this role you will play a key role in supporting and enhancing the vulnerability management process to strengthen the security posture of company’s products and solutions. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Driving and continuously improving the vulnerability management process.
* Staying up to date with emerging security threats, vulnerabilities, and industry best practices to continuously improve our vulnerability management program.
* Assessing identified vulnerabilities by analyzing their severity, exploitability, and relevance to our company’s products and solutions.
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams to define and implement effective remediation strategies and action plans.
* Supporting the development of mitigation plans to address vulnerabilities by applying patches, implementing alternative safeguards, or facilitating risk acceptance decisions.
* Advising stakeholders on security best practices and providing recommendations for effective vulnerability treatment.
* Reporting on vulnerability findings, remediation efforts, and overall security posture to senior management and relevant stakeholders.

What You Bring

* A university degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a comparable field
* Profound experience in cybersecurity, product security or OT security, preferebly in the energy sectore. Experience with widely recognized OT cybersecurity standards, including ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, and ISO 27001 is preferred. Experience with regulatory compliance requirements specific to OT environments (e.g., NIS2 NERC CIP, EU Cyber Resilience Act) is highly welcome.
* Deep expertise in vulnerability management, including conducting assessments, performing security testing, and developing remediation strategies
* Deep understanding of common security vulnerabilities, attack vectors, and exploitation techniques. Hands-on experience with industry-standard vulnerability scanning techniques and tools (e.g., Nessus, Qualys, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP)
* Familiarity with industry-standard SCA and SAST techniques and tools (BlackDuck, Snyk, SonarQube). Knowledge and experience with SCADA and Industrial Control Systems is preferred.
* Fluency in English and excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions and convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
* Relevant cybersecurity certifications such as CEH, OSCP, PNPT, GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Expert are highly welcome.

About the Team

Our Global Functions are essential in driving the company's strategic initiatives and ensuring operational excellence across various departments, business areas, and regions. These roles support our vision to become the most valued energy technology company in the world. As part of our team, you contribute to our vision by shaping the global energy transition, partnering with our internal and external stakeholders, and conducting business responsibly and in compliance with legal requirements and regulations.

The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive and competitive compensation package, you can expect a generous employer-funded retirement plan.
* We also offer the opportunity to become a shareholder in Siemens Energy at very favorable employee rates.
* Under our motto #BetterTogether, we provide our employees with the flexibility to work remotely or in the office. Our workspaces are designed to inspire collaboration and creativity, ensuring a fulfilling work environment.

jobs.occupation: Master Thesis in Aerodynamics in the  Gust Loads & Aeroelastics department (d/f/m) (Elektroniker/in - Luftfahrttechnische Systeme)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Gust Loads & Aeroelastics department, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Master student (d/f/m) in the field of Aerodynamics in the Gust Loads & Aeroelastics department

You are looking for a master thesis and want to get to know the work of a job title? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Gust Loads & Aeroelastics department as a master student (d/f/m)!

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: 01.06.2025
- Duration: 6 months

Your opportunity

- Are you passionate about aircraft physics?
- Are you keen to master the way we compute external loads acting on the vehicle due to maneuvers, flight in turbulence, landing impact, ground-handling?
- Do you like to work in an empowered manner?
- Do you enjoy connecting people and collaborating with many different interfaces?
- This job will give you the opportunity to work internationally with several internal flight physics departments and with teams located in Europe and India.

About us

We are a team of 16 multicultural and passionate engineers who perform the gust calculations for overall aircraft design for all aircraft types. Our team is involved from a very early design stage until certification and also in-service support. We are responsible for running build model activities such as finite element modeling, creating mass and aerodynamics models. We perform gust loads calculation, including failure cases, and deliver to internal interfaces. On top, we are deeply involved in research and technology aspects with new aircraft configuration assessments, model based system engineering, automation and machine learning.

Introduction

The current industry approaches of modeling unsteady aerodynamic flow for the prediction of gust loads typically assume linear flow conditions. Linearity greatly reduces the computational time required to evaluate all the flight points and gust conditions required by the certification specifications (CS-25). At the same time, disregarding non-linearities such as boundary layer separation arising from the high angles of attack induced by strong gusts can lead to an over-estimation of loads and thus to an increased structural weight of the aircraft.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Your benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

During this six months Master thesis you will develop and evaluate an unsteady aerodynamic model that includes the effect of flow separation in a piecewise linear approach. The model will be built using linearized computational fluid dynamics (CFD) of a complete flexible aircraft and adapted using aerodynamic data obtained in the non-linear flow region at high angles of attack. You will evaluate the model by comparison against higher-fidelity models, such as obtained from non-linear time domain simulation, with respect to gust loads.

You will contribute to:

- Optimize the design of Airbus commercial aircraft in the frame of new wing technologies
- the development of new approaches to model unsteady aerodynamics considering non-linearities for gust loads and flutter computation
- Actively support us as a new member of our team on our journey

Desired skills and qualifications

- You are a fulltime enrolled master student (d/f/m) within Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
- You have good knowledge in aerodynamics, CFD and potential flows
- Ideally you already have first experience in CFD using TAU or CODA
- You have knowledge in coding using Python and/or Matlab
- You bring basic knowledge in overall aircraft design and basic competencies in flight loads calculation and flight mechanics
- You are passionate to understand physical aspects and to use your engineering judgement
- If you are familiar with tools like MSC.NASTRAN or ALTAIR HyperWorks, this is beneficial
- You are a highly motivated, proactive and open-minded person with a great sense of initiative
- You are keen to deepen your technical knowledge while enjoying to work in a multicultural team
- Your English is at negotiating level

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.
